summary: Ocugen, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the departure of Huma Qamar, M.D., MPH, CMI, as Chief Medical Officer, effective May 8, 2026, and the appointment of Mohamed Genead, M.D., M.Sc., as Acting/Interim Chief Medical Officer on the same date. No reason or compensation terms are given. The board did not reference a recommendation or advisor. The change is executive-level but orderly, with an immediate interim replacement. Watch for any subsequent permanent appointment or further disclosures on the circumstances of the departure.
